nodes.query_text:
select cr.risk_band, count(distinct cr.account_id) as accounts,
    round(avg(cr.arr),2) as avg_arr, sum(cr.arr) as total_arr,
    round(avg(cr.composite_health),2) as avg_health,
    ib.avg_arr as industry_avg_arr
from "warehouse"."main"."churn_risk" cr
left join "warehouse"."main"."industry_bench" ib using (industry)
group by cr.risk_band, ib.avg_arr

select account_id, name, industry, country, arr, created_date, csm_id, health_score,
    arr/12.0 as implied_mrr, 
        (date_diff('day', created_date::timestamp, current_date::timestamp ))
     as age_days
from "warehouse"."main"."accounts"

select fu_id, account_id, feature_name, usage_date, usage_count,
    date_trunc('month',usage_date) as usage_month
from "warehouse"."main"."feature_usage"

select plan, is_active, count(distinct account_id) as accounts,
    sum(mrr) as total_mrr, round(avg(mrr),2) as avg_mrr, sum(seats) as seats
from "warehouse"."main"."stg_subscriptions"
group by plan, is_active

select sub_id, account_id, plan, seats, mrr, start_date, end_date, is_active, mrr*12 as arr
from "warehouse"."main"."subscriptions"

select ticket_id, account_id, created_ts, resolved_ts, priority, category,
    csat_score, is_resolved,
    
        (date_diff('hour', created_ts::timestamp, coalesce(resolved_ts,current_timestamp)::timestamp ))
     as ttr_hours,
    priority in ('high','critical') as is_urgent
from "warehouse"."main"."support_tickets"

select account_id, name, industry, country, arr, risk_band, composite_health, risk_rank,
    current_timestamp as report_ts
from "warehouse"."main"."churn_risk"
order by risk_rank

select a.account_id, a.name, a.industry, a.country, a.arr, a.age_days,
    a.health_score as raw_health,
    ae.total_events, ae.active_days, fb.features_used,
    coalesce(fb.features_used,0) as feature_count,
    coalesce(sh.urgent_tickets,0) as urgent_tickets,
    coalesce(sh.avg_csat,3) as avg_csat,
    least(100,round(a.health_score*0.3+least(ae.active_days,30)*0.4*(10.0/3)
        +coalesce(fb.features_used,0)*2-coalesce(sh.urgent_tickets,0)*3,2)) as composite_health
from "warehouse"."main"."stg_accounts" a
left join "warehouse"."main"."account_engagement" ae using (account_id)
left join "warehouse"."main"."feature_breadth" fb using (account_id)
left join "warehouse"."main"."support_health" sh using (account_id)

select industry, count(distinct account_id) as accounts,
    round(avg(arr),2) as avg_arr, round(avg(composite_health),2) as avg_health,
    sum(arr) as total_arr
from "warehouse"."main"."account_health"
group by industry

select account_id, count(distinct feature_name) as features_used,
    sum(usage_count) as total_usage, max(usage_date) as last_usage
from "warehouse"."main"."stg_feature_usage"
group by account_id

select plan, is_active, accounts, total_mrr, avg_mrr, seats,
    round(total_mrr*100.0/nullif(sum(total_mrr) over(partition by is_active),0),2) as mrr_share_pct,
    current_timestamp as report_ts
from "warehouse"."main"."mrr_by_plan"
order by is_active desc, total_mrr desc

select account_id, count(*) as total_tickets,
    count(*) filter (where is_urgent) as urgent_tickets,
    count(*) filter (where is_resolved) as resolved,
    round(CAST((avg(csat_score) filter (where csat_score is not null)) AS NUMERIC),2) as avg_csat,
    round(CAST((avg(ttr_hours) filter (where is_resolved)) AS NUMERIC),1) as avg_ttr
from "warehouse"."main"."stg_tickets"
group by account_id

select risk_band, accounts, total_arr, avg_health,
    round(total_arr*100.0/nullif(sum(total_arr) over(),0),2) as arr_share_pct,
    industry_avg_arr, current_timestamp as report_ts
from "warehouse"."main"."segment_summary"
order by avg_health

select industry, accounts, avg_arr, avg_health, total_arr,
    rank() over (order by total_arr desc) as arr_rank,
    current_timestamp as report_ts
from "warehouse"."main"."industry_bench"
order by total_arr desc

select event_id, account_id, user_id, event_type, event_ts, session_id, platform,
    date_trunc('day',event_ts) as event_day, date_trunc('week',event_ts) as event_week
from "warehouse"."main"."events"

select account_id, count(distinct event_id) as total_events,
    count(distinct user_id) as unique_users, count(distinct session_id) as sessions,
    count(distinct event_day) as active_days, max(event_ts) as last_seen
from "warehouse"."main"."stg_events"
group by account_id

select account_id, name, industry, country, arr, composite_health,
    case when composite_health<30 then 'CRITICAL' when composite_health<50 then 'AT_RISK'
         when composite_health<70 then 'NEUTRAL' else 'HEALTHY' end as risk_band,
    rank() over (order by composite_health) as risk_rank
from "warehouse"."main"."account_health"
